description: Département des Côtes d'Armor: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Côtes d'Armor. Coverage: Département des Côtes d'Armor. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Fibre optique : noeuds de la montée en débit dans le département des C; Fibre optique : cablage optique de la montée en débit dans le départem; Antennes du Conseil Départemental des Côtes d'Armor. Formats seen: URL, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
